title: Choose the mobile app's visual world
question: The roll assigned Pasar Malam. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. The bottom tab bar stays exactly as it is in every option.

options.label: Pasar Malam
options.lineage: Malaysian night-market rows: tarp canopies, painted stall boards, bulb-lit price tags
options.thesis: Every screen is a lit stall row: numbered section boards, and the figures that matter sit on bold painted price tags under a warm lamp.
options.viewport: Home: left-aligned big title, account row, numbered 'Discover' stall boards with amber price-tag figures, tab bar unchanged.
options.risk: A night world: light mode must become the daytime tarp market, or it reads as a dark-mode-only costume.

raised.raise: Fixed row furniture: every list entry carries the same name plate, one meta line and one note, in the same places, on every screen.
Hierarchy by type scale alone: card borders deleted, a real ramp from 12pt caption to 34pt title does the separating.
One invariant layout law: a single 20pt left edge for every title, label and figure; nothing centred except empty states.
Number-first type: large condensed figures against small tracked labels, so a KPI reads before its caption.

options.label: Stored-value Card
options.lineage: transit and e-wallet stored-value cards Malaysians tap daily
options.thesis: Your account is a card in the hand: a bold coloured pass with its key number, and every section below it reads like the card's statement.
options.viewport: Home: a full-width blue account pass at the top, statement-style rows under it, tab bar unchanged.
options.risk: Familiar: this is where most wallet and fintech apps land; distinct only if the card is committed and the statement rows are exact.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.thesis: Each section is a coloured line; its rows are stations on it, and interchanges mark where sections connect.
options.viewport: Home: sections as coloured line segments with station-tick rows, midnight ground, tab bar unchanged.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: grouped settings map to lines and KL commuters read line colours daily; loses narrowly on distinctiveness because transit-as-UI is well worn.
options.risk: Line ornament on every list gets busy; it needs the discipline to draw lines only where order matters.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Cards are coupons with a torn stub: state stamps itself on (verified, signed out, void) and nothing just disappears.
options.viewport: Home: an account coupon with a perforated stub, ruled fields below, tab bar unchanged.
options.case: Holds audience identification (vouchers and claims are RewardHub's core), loses product clarity on settings, PRs and devices, which are not coupons.
options.risk: Perforations and stamps everywhere become a costume on non-reward screens.

options.label: Metro Typographic Tiles
options.thesis: Type is the interface: giant lowercase, flat colour tiles, no chrome.
options.viewport: Panorama of cropped headlines over tile grid.
options.case: Loses both axes: users don't identify with it, and cropped headlines and panoramas fight a tabbed app.
options.risk: Reads as nostalgia for a dead OS.
options.kept: Hierarchy by type scale alone, borders deleted.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: A ranked roster of characters with name plates.
options.case: Loses both axes: the product has no cast and no mascots.
options.risk: Childish on a security and settings app.
options.kept: Fixed row furniture in the same place on every entry.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: A centre staff read upward, symbols as duration.
options.viewport: A vertical staff with flanking columns.
options.case: Loses both axes: no one in this audience reads it, and upward time contradicts every list.
options.kept: One invariant layout law held on every screen.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.thesis: Giant letterforms with tiny mono readouts.
options.viewport: One giant glyph over a breathing glyph grid.
options.case: Loses both axes: the product is not about type.
options.kept: Number-first scale contrast: big figures, small tracked labels.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished native-feeling account app: grouped inset lists, large titles, one accent, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Home: large title, grouped white list sections on a grey ground, tab bar unchanged.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every settings-heavy app by design.
